description: TRY_TO_TIME(expr [, format]) is the non-throwing TO_TIME: it parses a valid time and answers NULL instead of erroring on unparseable input. It shares the TRY_CAST source rule - an UNTYPED NULL errors (live-verified: Function TRY_CAST cannot be used with arguments of types NULL and TIME(9)) while NULL::VARCHAR converts to NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/TryToTimeTest (now retired); the Java compared a LocalTime toString, so the suite reads TO_VARCHAR.
